initialExam.title: Territorial Army Officer 2026
initialExam.description: Territorial Army officer entry for employed civilians to serve the nation part-time while continuing their civil profession.
initialExam.syllabus: Paper-I: Reasoning, Elementary Mathematics, General Knowledge, English. Paper-II: General Knowledge, English.
initialExam.examPattern: Paper-I: 100 marks, 2 hours. Paper-II: 100 marks, 2 hours. SSB Interview + Medical.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Written Exam → SSB Interview → Medical → Final Selection
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Apply through joinindianarmy.nic.in 2. Fill form 3. Pay fee 4. Appear for exam
initialExam.perks: Military allowances during training, CSD canteen, Medical
